messages:
taylor: Sharing a new "raincloud" tile prototype (box + density ridge + jitter). Link: https://redwood.design/protos/raincloud maria: Love the compactness. Two asks: 1) explicit unit control for axis & tooltips (ms / s), 2) indicate if density was clipped to avoid misinterpreting the shape jon: Smoothing concern: current KDE bandwidth hides short lived p99 spikes. Can we expose presets: none / adaptive / fixed-light? adaptive should respect burstiness kim: A11y: the ridge + jitter color combo fails for deuteranopia at small widths. Suggest palette-v5 + patterned ridge fallback. Also SR aria shouldn't just say "raincloud chart" taylor: Plan: add a small units dropdown in the legend labeled "Units (axis & tooltips)", smoothing presets in the top-right, and a clipping indicator on the axis when active. Clip density at 99.8% and render clipped items as larger outlined jitter dots with clear hit targets sam: If density is clipped, append axis label like: "Request latency (ms) — values clipped to 99.8%". Tooltip on clipped dots should show original value and timestamp + link to traces jon: +1. Also when switching to seconds, format ticks with 2 decimals for subsecond values. And when smoothing=adaptive, show a tiny badge with the bandwidth used on hover kim: SR copy suggestion: aria-label should be descriptive e.g. "Latency raincloud for /complete: median 39 ms; p95 128 ms; 2 outliers above 1s" and aria-describedby link to clipping explanation maria: Copy nit for legend helper: change from "Units" to "Units used by axis and tooltips" — less ambiguous for non-devs taylor: snippet I'll include in the PR for SR + focus: ```html
.raincloud .jitter:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); } ``` design-bot: Added checklist D-1607: units dropdown, smoothing presets, clipping badge + outlier interactions, palette-v5, SR description, keyboard focus on jitter dots sam: We'll need Storybook stories for: no smoothing, adaptive, fixed-light, and a clipped-data example. Add axe snapshots and a visual diff for patterned fills jon: tiny UX ask: legend should show a micro-toggle "density / box / both" so users can simplify view for reports maria: good idea. Also add an integration test that flips units + smoothing + density toggle to catch axis label regressions kim: :thumbsup:
